# Ben Young

> Design, UX and AI consultant with 21 years in digital. Based in Bournemouth, UK. Founder of Cernago and co-founder of Bookbag. Available for fractional, part-time and remote engagements, 2 to 3 days a week.

Ben works with mid-market B2B teams that need a senior product designer who can also ship. His edge is holding the whole loop end to end: discovery, design, AI-assisted build, deploy. That combination lets one person move from prototype to production without a dev team, closing the gap between the design that was drawn and the design that ships.

## What he does

1. UX and product design. Discovery, information architecture, wireframing, prototyping, interface and visual design, design systems, usability testing.
2. AI-assisted development. Designing and building production websites and web apps end to end with AI, no dev team.
3. AI and automation. Multi-agent workflows, AI content pipelines, image generation, API integrations.
4. Consultancy and auditing. UX and website audits, positioning, go to market, AI search visibility (AEO / GEO) audits with prioritised roadmaps.

## Career

- 2005 to 2006: Web Designer, Bearweb Design
- 2006 to 2012: Lead Designer and Web Designer, Redweb
- 2012 to 2015: Creative Director, Redweb
- 2015 to 2021: Experience Director, Createful
- 2021 to present: Founder and Consultant, Cernago Limited
- 2025 to present: Co-founder, Bookbag

## Ventures

- [Cernago](https://cernago.com): B2B growth consultancy. Predictable pipeline for B2B companies: positioning, structured outbound, paid media and AI-driven sales tooling as one joined-up system.
- [Bookbag](https://bookbagmedia.com): the advertising channel that funds primary schools. Print activity sheets distributed through school bookbags, revenue shared with schools.

## Selected clients

Channel 4, WWF, Philips, UN Environment Programme, The Royal Society, Royal College of Surgeons, Vodafone, Department for Education, UNEP Finance Initiative, ISEAL Alliance, Global Canopy.
